column1: # RAW CAPTURE — NFL.com official league standings, 2026 regular season — CLOSEOUT READ (post-MNF)
# Read window (UTC): opened after 2026-11-17T04:39:46Z, completed before 2026-11-17T04:43:14Z
#   (standings fetched in 2 content chunks by the session's page-fetch tool; window bracketed by
#   sandbox clock readings). The Monday-night final (LAC 23, BAL 20) was decided at ~04:29Z.
# OFFICIAL-SOURCE OBSERVATION (recorded, not inferred): after the final, the league-standings
# route printed the PRE-GAME state at four separate reads (04:30:44Z, 04:34:34Z, 04:39:46Z and
# ~04:41Z: LAC 0-8, 121/219, 8L; BAL 4-5, 189/236, 4L — byte-identical to the pre-game values
# derived from data/results_2026-11-16.tsv and to session e97f05c3's S90 read), while the
# division-standings route of the SAME official site already carried the final result at the
# same time (LAC 1-8, 144/239, 1W; BAL 4-6, 209/259, 5L). This capture therefore takes all 32
# rows from the FRESH division route; the 30 clubs with no Monday game are byte-identical on
# both routes. Column layout identical to the league route and to data/standings.tsv.
# Purpose: the closeout points-arithmetic gate (promote_week10.py P4/P6) needs a standings
# read that includes the Monday-night final; this is that read. It does NOT replace
# data/standings.tsv (canonical capture, pre-registration corpus state) and does NOT replace
# session e97f05c3's data/standings_2026-11-17.tsv (their pre-MNF same-day read, preserved).
